arxiv-2111-13519.title: Graph Auto-Encoders for Financial Clustering
arxiv-2111-13519.creator: Edward Turner
arxiv-2111-13519.description: Abstract Deep learning has shown remarkable results on Euclidean data (e.g. audio, images, text) however this type of data is limited in the amount of relational information it can hold. In mathematics we can model more general relational data in a graph structure while retaining Euclidean data as associated node or edge features.

arxiv-2206-14557.title: Hopf and pre-Lie algebras in regularity structures
arxiv-2206-14557.creator: Ilya Chevyrev
arxiv-2206-14557.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ilya Chevyrev. These lecture notes aim to present the algebraic theory of regularity structures as developed in [ Hairer14 , BHZ19 , BCCH21 ] . The main aim of this theory is to build a systematic approach to renormalisation of singular SPDEs; together with complementary analytic results, these works give a general solution theory for a wide class of semilinear parabolic singular SPDEs in the subcritical regime.

arxiv-2301-05074.title: Identification of light leptons and pions in the electromagnetic calorimeter of Belle II Journal: Nucl. Instr. Meth. A
arxiv-2301-05074.creator: Anja Novosel, Abtin Narimani Charan, Luka Šantelj, Torben Ferber, Peter Križan, Boštjan Golob
arxiv-2301-05074.description: Abstract The paper discusses new method for electron/pion and muon/pion separation in the Belle II detector at transverse momenta below 0.7 GeV/ c c , which is essential for efficient measurements of semi-leptonic decays of B B mesons with tau lepton in the final state.

arxiv-2303-13088.title: Upper limit on scalar field dark matter from LIGO-Virgo third observation run
arxiv-2303-13088.description: Abstract If dark matter is a light scalar field weakly interacting with elementary particles, such a field induces oscillations of the physical constants, which results in time-varying force acting on macroscopic objects. In this paper, we report on a search for such a signal in the data of the two LIGO detectors during their third observing run (O3).

arxiv-2306-01820.title: Concurrent Classifier Error Detection (CCED) in Large Scale Machine Learning Systems
arxiv-2306-01820.creator: Pedro Reviriego, Ziheng Wang, Álvaro Alonso, Zhen Gao, Farzad Niknia, Shanshan Liu, Fabrizio Lombardi
arxiv-2306-01820.description: Abstract The complexity of Machine Learning (ML) systems increases each year, with current implementations of large language models or text-to-image generators having billions of parameters and requiring billions of arithmetic operations. As these systems are widely utilized, ensuring their reliable operation is becoming a design requirement. Traditional error detection mechanisms introduce circuit or time redundancy that significantly impacts system performance.

arxiv-2410-04656.title: Nonuniform complete observability; preservation by output feedback and duality results Thanks: This research has been partially supported by the grant FONDECYT Regular 1210733
arxiv-2410-04656.creator: Ignacio Huerta
arxiv-2410-04656.description: Abstract . In this paper we propose a new observability property for nonautonomous linear control systems in finite dimension; the nonuniform complete observability, which is more general than the uniform complete observability. The main result of this work will prove that nonuniform complete observability is preserved via output feedback.

arxiv-2412-12341.title: Analytical results for the distribution of first return times of non-backtracking random walks on configuration model networks
arxiv-2412-12341.creator: Dor Lev-Ari, Ido Tishby, Ofer Biham, Eytan Katzav, Diego Krapf
arxiv-2412-12341.description: Abstract We present analytical results for the distribution of first return (FR) times of non-backtracking random walks (NBWs) on undirected configuration model networks consisting of N N nodes with degree distribution P ⁡ ( k ) P(k) . We focus on the case in which the network consists of a single connected component.

arxiv-2503-04190.title: Personalized Emotion Detection from Floor Vibrations Induced by Footsteps
arxiv-2503-04190.creator: Yuyan Wu, Yiwen Dong, Sumer Vaid, Gabriella M. Harari, Hae Young Noh
arxiv-2503-04190.description: Abstract Emotion recognition is critical for various applications, including the early detection of mental health disorders and emotion-based smart home systems. Previous studies utilized various sensing methods for emotion recognition, such as wearable sensors, cameras, and microphones. However, these methods have limitations in long-term domestic use because of the inherent limitations, including intrusiveness and privacy concerns.

arxiv-2503-20237.title: A Virtual Fencing Framework for Safe and Efficient Collaborative Robotics
arxiv-2503-20237.creator: Vineela Reddy Pippera Badguna, Aliasghar Arab, Durga Avinash Kodavalla
arxiv-2503-20237.description: Abstract Collaborative robots (cobots) increasingly operate alongside humans, demanding robust real-time safeguarding. Current safety standards (e.g., ISO 10218, ANSI/RIA 15.06, ISO/TS 15066) require risk assessments but offer limited guidance for real-time responses. We propose a virtual fencing approach that detects and predicts human motion, ensuring safe cobot operation.

arxiv-2509-11143.title: Inflationary trispectrum of gauge fields from scalar and tensor exchanges
arxiv-2509-11143.creator: P. Jishnu Sai, S. R. Haridev, and Rajeev Kumar Jain
arxiv-2509-11143.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by P. Jishnu Sai, S. R. Haridev, and Rajeev Kumar Jain. In this paper, we compute the inflationary trispectrum of primordial gauge fields generated through the scalar and tensor exchanges in models with spectator U ⁡ ( 1 ) U(1) gauge fields which are kinetically coupled to the inflaton.

arxiv-2602-09289.title: Triggered: A Statistical Analysis of Environmental Influences on Extremist Groups
arxiv-2602-09289.creator: Christine de Kock, Eduard Hovy
arxiv-2602-09289.description: Abstract Online extremist communities operate within a wider information ecosystem shaped by real-world events, news coverage, and cross-community interaction. We adopt a systems perspective to examine these influences using seven years of data from two ideologically distinct extremist forums (Stormfront and Incels) and a mainstream reference community (r/News).

pmc-10496155.title: Symptoms of SARS-CoV-2 infection and vaccine status of sixty-seven adult patients affected by inherited metabolic diseases: a phone survey
pmc-10496155.creator: Lucia Brodosi, Michele Stecchi, Dorina Mita, Francesca Marchignoli, Valeria Guarneri, Giulio Agnelli, Valentino Osti, Federica Perazza, Federica Sacilotto, Andrea Pession, Loris Pironi
pmc-10496155.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundThe Covid pandemic seems to have had several detrimental effects on managing patients affected by inherited metabolic diseases (IMD), although published data about the impact of COVID-19 on patients suffering from IMD are very scarce. The scope of our work was to evaluate adherence to the vaccination plan, the side effects experienced by our adult IMD patients, and the symptoms of the SARS-CoV-2 infection.ResultsSixty-seven patients agreed to respond to a phone interview. The mean age was 36.5 (± 11.6 SD).

pmc-10689337.title: Treatments for Moderate-to-Severe Alopecia Areata: A Systematic Narrative Review
pmc-10689337.creator: Alexander Egeberg, Louise Linsell, Erin Johansson, Frederick Durand, Guanglei Yu, Sergio Vañó-Galván
pmc-10689337.description: Treatments for alopecia areata (AA) have traditionally been prescribed off-label, and there has been no universal agreement on how to best manage the condition. Baricitinib is the first oral selective Janus kinase (JAK) inhibitor approved for the treatment of adults with severe AA.

pmc-11447138.title: Retrospektive Analyse des Schockraummanagements nichttraumatologisch kritisch kranker Kinder in einer universitären zentralen Notaufnahme (OBSERvE-DUS-PED-Studie)
pmc-11447138.creator: Claudia Priebe, Hans Martin Bosse, Mark Michael, Olaf Picker, Michael Bernhard, Juliane Tautz
pmc-11447138.description: HintergrundDie Etablierung eines nichttraumatologischen Schockraummanagements für kritisch kranke Kinder erscheint sinnvoll. In der vorliegenden Studie wurden Versorgungsdaten kritisch kranker nichttraumatologischer pädiatrischer Schockraumpatienten erhoben.MethodenIn der retrospektiven OBSERvE-DUS-PED-Studie (November 2019 bis Oktober 2022) wurden pädiatrische Patienten (Alter < 18 Jahre), die eine Schockraumversorgung aus nichttraumatologischer Ursache benötigten und der zentralen Notaufnahme zugeführt wurden, erfasst.

pmc-12443685.title: The role of interferon regulatory factors in atherosclerosis
pmc-12443685.creator: Yingsong Wang, Tianxiang Fang, Xiaoya Zheng, Ning Huangfu
pmc-12443685.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) remain a leading cause of global morbidity and mortality, largely driven by the progression of atherosclerotic plaques. In atherosclerosis (AS), transcription factors and epigenetic mechanisms play pivotal roles in regulating gene expression. Interferon regulatory factors (IRFs), a family of transcription factors initially identified for their role in coordinating interferon (IFN) responses, are now recognized as critical modulators of innate and adaptive immunity.

pmc-12506281.title: Early-third-trimester uterine rupture in an unscarred primigravida with a didelphic uterus: a case report
pmc-12506281.creator: Tirusew Nigussie Kebede, Getaneh Dejen Tiche, Tebabere Moltot Kitaw, Birhan Tsegaw Taye, Moges Sisay Chekole, Tesfanesh Lema, Mulualem Sileshi, Girma Wogie Fitie, Mesfin Tadese, Kidist Ayalew Abebe, Legesse Demissie, Zekarias Taye
pmc-12506281.description: IntroductionUterus didelphys, one of the rarest types of Müllerian anomaly, is characterized by the presence of two separate uterine horns and/or two distinct cervices due to the failure of Müllerian duct fusion. It is associated with poor obstetric outcomes, including spontaneous abortion, preterm labor, fetal malpresentation, and, rarely, uterine rupture.

pmc-12990794.title: Immediate Versus Delayed Sequential Bilateral Cataract Surgery: A Systematic Review
pmc-12990794.creator: Samar Al-Swailem, Khabir Ahmad, Abdulaziz Jabr AlJbreen, Sara AlHilali
pmc-12990794.description: ObjectiveTo compare the visual outcomes, safety, and patient-reported outcomes of ISBCS versus DSBCS in adults undergoing cataract surgery.Evidence ReviewA systematic search of PubMed, Embase, CENTRAL, Web of Science, and gray literature (conference abstracts, registries) was conducted for studies published up to March 2023.

pmc-13285954.title: A manually curated gene–phenotype catalogue for progeroid syndromes and premature aging
pmc-13285954.creator: Nuša Likar, Tanja Kunej
pmc-13285954.description: Progeroid syndromes (PS) are a heterogeneous group of rare hereditary disorders with features resembling premature aging, thereby serving as valuable models for studying human aging biology. However, data on these syndromes remain fragmented across literature sources, with inconsistent terminology and classifications hindering systematic analyses.

pmc-13357998.title: Harnessing piezoelectricity for bone tissue engineering: recapitulating the electrophysiological microenvironment through smart biomaterials
pmc-13357998.creator: Bo Shao, Yu He, Guiyun Wang, Zhuang Liu, Suqin Wang
pmc-13357998.description: Natural bone tissue is a highly dynamic electrophysiological microenvironment, where endogenous piezoelectricity plays a pivotal role in regulating bone remodeling and homeostasis. Addressing the complex clinical challenges of bone defects, piezoelectric biomaterials have emerged as a revolutionary self-powered therapeutic strategy, reconstructing this critical biophysical niche through electromechanical conversion.
